note: Literature confirms high penetrance of optic atrophy and retinal dystrophy in FDXR cohorts, with sensorineural hearing loss/auditory neuropathy present in only a subset (e.g., 5/10).

evidence.text: In a cohort of 10 individuals with biallelic FDXR variants, all had bilateral optic atrophy, 7 of 10 had retinal dystrophy, and only 5 of 10 had sensorineural hearing loss.

source.title: Associated Disease Phenotype: Retinal Dystrophy Is a Recurrent ...
source.quote: In addition to bilateral optic atrophy and variable extra-ocular findings, 7 of 10 individuals manifested retinal dystrophy comprising dysfunction and degeneration of both rod and cone photoreceptors. Five of 10 subjects had sensorineural hearing loss.

evidence.text: In a Chinese cohort of five patients with biallelic FDXR variants, all presented with optic atrophy and retinal dystrophy.

source.title: FDXR-associated disease in a Chinese cohort
source.quote: In addition to optic atrophy and diverse extraocular manifestations, all patients presented with retinal dystrophy, and electroretinogram showed severely impaired cone and rod functions in their first decades.
